It conveys a sense of respect, admiration, and trust, as well as the expectation of competence and expertise from the person bearing this name.

The Quran teaches us that every believer is a steward of their own affairs, responsible for managing the resources and blessings they have been given by Allah. Additionally, the name could be seen as a reflection of the ideal Muslim personality, who strives to be the best version of themselves in their roles as leaders, parents, students, or employees, seeking Allah's guidance and success in all their endeavors.
